findings.title: The small-action button no longer floats to the right
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container causes its button child to ignore the existing `float: right`. Since `.small-action-desc` has no flex-grow, the button can sit directly beside the message instead of at the far right, changing the placement of the action control. Give the description flexible space or push the button to the end with a flex-compatible rule.

findings.title: The legacy flexbox fallback may not keep the panel right-aligned
findings.body: For browsers that use the `-webkit-box` or `-moz-box` fallback but do not support modern flexbox, `margin-left: auto` does not provide the modern flex auto-margin behavior that pushes the panel to the right. The previous `float: right` has also been removed, so the panel can sit beside the title rather than at the right edge.

findings.title: The old Firefox flexbox fallback omits its alignment property
findings.body: `flexbox()` emits `display: -moz-box` for older Firefox, but `align-items()` does not emit the corresponding `-moz-box-align`. In browsers using that fallback, requested vertical alignment (such as the header's `center`) is ignored and the items use the old box model's default alignment. Add the matching legacy property or remove the fallback.
